name: CIG Campo Lateral
researcher_notes: The line was completed in July 1998 under FERC docket CP97-769 and is already built. The Energy Information Administration historical projects sheet (August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 76) lists 115 miles, 16 inch, 100 MMcf/d. A 2002 Federal Register notice on the Raton Basin amendment describes the Campo Lateral 16 inch loop as 24.20 miles, reduced from 28.14. The two lengths conflict and no document found settles which is right, so no sourced length exists. The line is a lateral of the Colorado Interstate Gas system, which the tracker already carries as P0168, and it has no row of its own. Not added because the length is uncertain and the project is historical, not a new announcement. If it is ever added, check the 1998 FERC certificate order for CP97-769 for the as-built length.
